reforge._comment: Hub gamble: pay gold to re-roll an owned item's base quality (50-110) from this published table. The new roll REPLACES the old one - there is no keep-best - and sharpening is never touched. A drop rolls 72.8 on average at key 1 (loot.json quality buckets); this table's mean is 71.5, deliberately a little lower, so reforging an average item is a slightly losing bet and only pays off for a low roll (below about 70) or as a lottery ticket: 5.0% to land 100-110, 0.1% for the 110 jackpot, 50% to land below 70. Chances sum to 1; bands lie inside 50..=110 and do not overlap. Cost is a gold sink that scales with the item: gold + per_item_level x item level + per_sharpening_level x the item's sharpening level (a loot item, level 5, unsharpened: 150 gold, a little over one dungeon run's gold income; a +4 epic of level 12: 210 gold; a +10 one: 490). Priced so that gold keeps a use all the way to best-in-slot: see docs/balance/economy.md. eligible.allow_broken: a broken item keeps its penalty whatever it rolls, so it is refused.
